deep_dive.executive_summary: San Juan Basin Royalty Trust is a passive gas NPI royalty with zero distributions since May 2024 while Hilcorp recovers excess production costs. FY2025 10-K confirms zero royalty income and no unit-holder distributions; Q1 2026 10-Q shows net deficit $4.64 million after $1.69 million net recovery in the quarter. Cash is $14,380; line of credit $750,514; going-concern doubt is disclosed. At ~$4.15 (Yahoo, May 26, 2026), total synthesis headline is 14.51% over eight years ($6.50 payoff); bull 19.4% in six years if gas spikes and costs clear fast.
